title: Login with the existing account
goal: Open the application, log in using the existing account credentials, and verify that the home screen is displayed.
expected: The home screen should be displayed

title: Search and open a product
precondition: Log in with the existing account credentials (the app starts logged out).
goal: Search for Pizza, open Margherita Pizza and verify that its name and price are displayed correctly.
expected: The product name "Margherita Pizza" is displayed
The selected product's price is displayed correctly

title: Add two products to the cart and change a quantity
precondition: Log in with the existing account credentials (the app starts logged out).
goal: Add Pepperoni Feast and Margherita Pizza to the cart. Increase the quantity of Pepperoni Feast to 2 and verify both products in the cart.
expected: Pepperoni Feast has the correct quantity of 2

title: Checkout and order confirmation
precondition: Log in with the existing account credentials (the app starts logged out).
goal: Search for Pepperoni Feast, open its details, set the quantity to 2, add it to the cart, proceed to checkout, complete the order and verify the order confirmation.
expected: The order should be placed successfully
The order confirmation screen displays the correct order information

title: Placed order appears in My Orders
precondition: Log in with the existing account credentials (the app starts logged out).
goal: Place an order for Margherita Pizza, open My Orders and verify that the newly placed order appears with the correct product and order status.
expected: The newly placed order appears in My Orders
"Margherita Pizza" is shown in the order
The order shows an order status

title: Change the application language
precondition: Log in with the existing account credentials (the app starts logged out).
goal: Open Settings, change the application language to another available language, and verify that the interface text is updated.
expected: The interface text is displayed in the selected language

title: Notification preference persists
precondition: Log in with the existing account credentials (the app starts logged out).
goal: Open Settings, enable a notification preference, save the changes if required, and verify that the preference remains enabled when reopening Settings.
expected: The notification preference is saved successfully
The notification preference remains enabled when Settings is reopened
